## TRA Timeline

#### Form-of TRA filed in abandoned IPO registration

- 2017-03-27?: Form-of TRA first appears as exhibit to confidential DRS/A (origin date inferred from earliest exhibit filing date; preamble dated `[ ], 2017`)
- 2017-04-10: Same form-of TRA re-filed as Exhibit 10.27 to public S-1
- 2018-03-22: Final S-1/A Amendment No. 4 filed; registration thereafter went stale with no 424B prospectus and no IPO 8-K

#### Abandonment

- 2021-02-02: CIK 0001693853 renamed from Vine Resources Inc. to Vine Energy Inc.; 2017 form-of TRA never executed

## Explanation

Vine Resources Inc. filed a confidential DRS in early 2017 and a public S-1 on April 10, 2017 with a form-of Tax Receivable Agreement attached as Exhibit 10.27, contemplating a single-bucket Up-C TRA paying 85% of cash tax savings on Section 754 basis step-ups and imputed interest from future LLC Unit exchanges. The 2017 IPO was abandoned: no 424B prospectus or IPO 8-K Item 1.01 was filed, and the final S-1/A Amendment No. 4 (March 22, 2018) was the last filing in the 2017 registration. The form-of TRA was never executed (blank preamble date, blank signature blocks, blank schedules). The same CIK was renamed Vine Energy Inc. in February 2021 and went public under a structurally different TRA later that quarter, but the 2017 instrument is a separate contemplated contract that simply never came into legal force. See `contract_log.md` for the form-of text reference and the distinction from the 2021 TRA.
